page.overview:
What is Vulture Peak?

Vulture Peak is a cloud-layered mountain that touches Heaven, with ranges that turn and circle, folding upwards. It is decorated with beautiful pines and cedars, as well as flowers too rare to have names. Arhats and lay-sisters reside on the mountain and lecture.
